## Custom quizzes

- Choose 1-24 hours of voting with `/dilemma custom`. The default uses the server's voting duration.
- Each server can start one custom quiz per calendar day. Its separate quota renews at midnight in the server's timezone.
- Polish and English help and command feedback describe the new limits.

## Upgrade from v3.13.0

Re-register the Discord commands to update the available voting durations. The existing database schema supports this release.
